# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

<!-- cap-evolve:meta-insights-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001 (first, empty seed)
- Strategy tried: diagnose all 10 val tasks from reward_info + traces, cluster by root cause, ship a bundle of SAFE code fixes each verified offline against the real airline DB (tau2 venv at `.cache/capevolve-ci/venv-skillberry-tau2`). Applied 4 distinct edit types (new loop tool, in-body fill, normalization, computation) + enriched errors + docs.
- What helped the search: the offline DB + importable tools.py made every guard/tool verifiable before submit; reward_info `action_checks` gave the exact expected reservation ids/args to identify (not overfit) the failure class.
- Key structural insight: the recurring failures split into (a) IDENTIFICATION gaps (agent can't see reservation details to pick the right one) → fixed with a read/loop tool, and (b) ARG-FILLING/COMPUTE friction (wrong keys, wrong totals) → fixed with normalization + autofill. Both are bounded/no-op-on-correct-input, i.e. low regression risk — the right first move for a mid-capability reader.
- What to try next: if this plateaus, the remaining zeros (task 37 flight re-quote, task 12/23 price splits) need either a cabin-change price-preview tool or leaving them (flaky/complex). Avoid touching cancel_reservation and update_reservation_flights logic (regression risk to task 19/37).
